title: Precious Lord, take my hand
lyrics: Chorus 1:
[G]Precious Lord, tak[G7]e my hand
Lead me[C] on, let me stand
I'm ti[G]red, I'm weak, I'm [D7]worn
Throug[G]h the storm, thro[G7]ugh the night
Lead [G]me on to the lig[D7]ht
Take[G] my hand precious Lord, lead me home
Verse 1:
When my way grows drear precious Lord linger near
When my life is almost gone
Hear my cry, hear my call
Hold my hand lest I fall
Take my hand precious Lord, lead me home
Verse 2:
When the darkness appears and the night draws near
And the day is past and gone
At the river I stand
Guide my feet, hold my hand
Take my hand precious Lord, lead me home
Verse 3:
When my work is all done
And my race here is are you-un
Let me see-ee by the light
Thou hast shown
That fair city so bright
Where the lantern is the li-ight
Take my ha-and, precious Lor-ord
Lead me on
